color.$description: Colour, two modes: dark is :root (the default), light is :root[data-theme="light"]. From web/app.css at Pinned 0.1.11.

app.$description: The one flat colour behind the whole app, sidebar included (html, body::before).

page.$description: The ground of the save page; the text of the chosen How to save tab.

screen.$description: The ring around the tick badge of the All sorted pile.

base.$description: Cards, the search, fields, list rows while moving.

raised.$description: Menus, the palette, toasts, the chosen segment, the kbd keys.

sheet.$description: Sheets and dialogs where they are solid.

recess.$description: The back card of the All sorted pile.

folder.$description: Folder tiles and the folder chips.

favicon-blank.$description: The tile behind a letter, a favicon without colour of its own, a favicon that fails.

default.$description: Hairlines and the rim of cards and fields.

strong.$description: Buttons, menus, the selection bar, scrollbars.

weak.$description: Secondary text: counts, hosts, labels, placeholders.

faint.$description: The faintest text, the key names of How to save.

default.$description: The one accent: the plus, Save, the picked tick, focus outlines.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on the accent.

text.$description: The accent as text: text buttons, links, toast actions.
